mapper.insert: insert into citations (id, message_id, seq, source_name, snippet, uri) values (#{id}, #{messageId}, #{seq}, #{sourceName}, #{snippet}, #{uri})
mapper.select: select c.id, c.message_id, c.seq, c.source_name, c.snippet, c.uri, c.created_at from citations c join messages m on c.message_id = m.id where m.conversation_id = #{conversationId} order by c.message_id, c.seq asc
